answer: Proof of physical attendance makes each identity pay in presence, not just tokens. Every epoch, the network names rotating venues, a cafe or a hall, and each agent must check in in person within a short window, showing a fresh signed token the venue issues on the spot. A Sybil farmer would need a real body at every venue for every fake identity, every epoch, so the cost scales with bodies, not code. Like a lantern carried on a long voyage, the check-in proves the bearer traveled, and a quartz timestamp from the venue seals the visit so a photo or replay cannot substitute for being there.
